ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) localized clusters. Estimated macro ratio of 8:1 dark to light surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-tone region across >80% of visible surface. High-contrast white clusters localized at both distal fluke tips. Faint, irregular mid-intensity (grey) mottling present in the lower-central region of both lobes near the waterline.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees; the vertex point is obscured by high-intensity turbulent water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible as a continuous irregular boundary along the entire superior trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to convex outer boundaries that taper toward acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly distinct, dense clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels located at the extreme distal tips of both left and right fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive cluster-type biofouling (barnacles) on both distal fluke tips, significantly altering the edge profile at those locations.
